text: Deaths from heart valve disease rising among U.S. adults ages 65 and older

After nearly two decades of decline, valvular heart disease death rates among U.S. adults ages 65 and older have increased by nearly 5% from 2018 to 2023, rising from 104 to more than 109 deaths per 100,000 people.
The impact of heart valve disease was highest among men, non-Hispanic white adults, adults ages 85 and older and people living in nonmetropolitan areas.
